levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than three ingredients used, or the order doesn't make sense.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least three ingredients, assembled in a logical order.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: At least three ingredients, logical order, and the learner explains why that order was chosen.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Item is not actually ready to eat, for example it still needs assembly.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Item is fully assembled and ready to eat.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Item is fully assembled, ready to eat, and neatly presented.

lookFors: Confidence rating ties to a specific real step from the task.
Assembly order matches what was actually planned in the warm-up or independent notes.
No adult step-by-step direction was needed during assembly.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
